links.outcome: Perceived preparedness and availability of AI-specific training among imaging professionals
links.effect: 68.3% did not feel well trained/prepared to implement AI in practice; 87.6% noted non-availability of specific training; 93% said AI education should be in undergraduate programs.
links.quote: Participants (68.3%) did not feel well trained/prepared to implement AI in their practice, highlighting the non-availability of specific training (87.6%).

links.outcome: Confidence with AI terminology among participants using AI clinically
links.effect: AI used by 43% of participants in clinical practice, but 63.8% of them did not feel confident with AI terminology.
links.quote: AI is being used by 43% of participants in clinical practice, but 63.8% of them did not feel confident with AI terminology.

screen.reason: Survey of medical imaging professionals evaluating their real-world experience, perceptions, and training gaps regarding AI in clinical radiography practice.
